title: Flash Sale Inventory Lock & Reservation Engine
scenario: During a flash sale event, tens of thousands of shoppers add limited-stock SKUs to their cart. Each cart item is granted a 10-minute temporary inventory reservation. If the customer does not checkout within 10 minutes, the reserved inventory must immediately expire and be reallocated to the next customer waiting in the priority queue.
algorithmic_pattern: Min-Heap for reservation TTL expiration coupled with a Hash Map for SKU stock counters.
sample_constraints: Immediate stock availability check in O(1) time
Reallocation of expired items in O(log K) time
example_problem_flavor: Given sequential operations (RESERVE, CHECKOUT, CANCEL) with timestamps, maintain active inventory counts and return the list of items reclaimed due to timeout.

title: Warehouse Automated Picking Route Optimization
scenario: An autonomous mobile robot (AMR) in an automated fulfillment center receives a customer order batch containing items located in N distinct shelf bins on a 2D warehouse grid. The robot must start from the packing station, visit every shelf bin holding an order item, and return to the packing station with minimal travel distance.
algorithmic_pattern: Shortest path BFS/Dijkstra combined with Travelling Salesperson Problem (TSP) using Bitmask Dynamic Programming.
sample_constraints: Number of item shelf locations N <= 16
Warehouse grid dimensions up to 100x100 with blocked aisles
example_problem_flavor: Compute the minimum Manhattan distance path for an AMR to collect all K target goods and return to base.

title: Shipment Package Weight Bin Packing
scenario: An air freight logistics courier needs to load parcels into standardized cargo shipping containers. Each container has a maximum weight capacity W. To optimize freight costs, the packer must fit as many parcels as possible into the fewest number of containers.
algorithmic_pattern: Greedy Best-Fit Decreasing or First-Fit Decreasing with Two Pointers / Binary Search.
sample_constraints: Parcels array length up to 50,000 items
Max weight capacity W up to 10,000 kg
example_problem_flavor: Determine the minimum number of cargo containers required to pack all packages without exceeding weight constraints.
